title: Exercise training for blood pressure: a systematic review and meta-analysis
journal: Journal of the American Heart Association
population: 93 randomised trials in healthy adults published to February 2012, with 105 endurance, 29 dynamic resistance, 14 combined and 5 isometric resistance training groups (3401 exercise, 1822 control participants)
funder: V.A.C. is supported as a postdoctoral fellow by Research Foundation Flanders (FWO).
result: Systolic pressure fell after endurance (-3.5 mm Hg, 95% CI -4.6 to -2.3), dynamic resistance (-1.8, -3.7 to -0.011) and isometric resistance training (-10.9, -14.5 to -7.4), but not after combined training. After endurance training the fall was larger in 26 groups with hypertension (-8.3/-5.2 mm Hg) than in 50 prehypertensive groups (-2.1/-1.7) and 29 normotensive groups (-0.75/-1.1). The outcomes were resting blood pressures.
